% T_rules, note below the table. Generated by analysis/paper_assets_isc.py; do not edit.
The table gives how often the reported prediction differs between two platforms, by rule and number of seeds. It is a follow-up analysis of the frozen outputs and is descriptive. Top-1 flip of the reported prediction, in \%, on 60 targets. Rates are per prediction at one seed and per target at five. Full-precision score: AlphaFold 3's rule. Two-decimal: ties to the lowest seed and sample. Tie within t: a tie is declared when the top two scores differ by at most t, and a flip needs one sample on each side. Tie: units with a tie on either side.
